[2026-08-21T02:14:34.525Z] [world] A wall of grey ash rolls across the plain. Breathing burns. Skin gathers a film of dead world.

You are at Asgardar. The ancient capital of Tartaria. Its collector-tower, the Grand Spire of Asgardar, still stands out past the last streets and once channeled cosmic Aether into the city grid.

Hazard: Magnetic Distortion. Compasses spin. Iron-cored gear stops working. The ground tugs at every buckle and bracket.
